status: read-only research; no production recovery enabled
inventory_scope: Selected 2242 UniTask / 1936 survivors / 923 Limbus methods, not a full-game scan.
Same-block register MOVD last-writer followed by CVTDQ2PS, within 512 contiguous suffix instructions. This is not an inventory of all integer conversions.

Research-only backwards predecessor walk accepts unanimous exact non-byref Int32 entry-parameter origins, following exact MOV r32,r32 copies. Metadata and hidden-sret/instance ABI positions define entry registers, not variable text.

One total 512-state budget includes the suffix and native predecessor trace; volatile GPRs do not survive direct calls, Win64 nonvolatile copies can. Partial writes, arithmetic writers, mixed roots, cycles and unsupported flow decline.
Only exact caller-owned x64 Win64 native contexts with unique non-generic entry metadata are considered. Indirect calls/branches and external branch targets decline the whole context.

An initial overstrict private probe rejected exact terminal INT3 trap/padding. The revised private census treats only Code.INT3 as a no-successor terminator and reruns all three fixtures. Production code was never changed.

coverage: entry Int32 origin, exact 32-bit copies, nonvolatile save across calls
volatile clobber, arithmetic and partial writers, conflicting roots
same-root branch join, backward cycle, shared/generic signature rejection
hidden-sret positional shift and one total state budget

remaining_proof_obligations: The private predecessor model is not a production recognizer or whole-method semantic proof. Independently decode candidate paths and verify actual ownership, native register alias/writer semantics, entry ABI and metadata identity.
Prove conversion-point source expression identity and lifetime, address escapes and exceptional/funclet paths; source-text equality alone must never establish the origin.
Preserve zero high lanes for legacy MOVD and snapshot the low float exactly at CVTDQ2PS. Never cast an unknown object, bound temp or aggregate token numerically.
Do not generalize the existing field proof, relax RBP/frame, aggregate/address/overlap, interface-sret or scalar-home guards, or infer all GPR/packed/high-lane conversions.
Keep opaque domain/error-helper calls and their argument semantics; no sqrtf replacement or broad Math.Sqrt repair is justified.
A production candidate needs authored boundary tests, game re-lifts, frozen suites, paired tree/compiler diagnostics and clean-parent behavioral reproduction before acceptance.
limitations: All selected bodies remain byte-identical to game_out56. No compilation-error reduction, source recovery or speed gain is claimed for this read-only study.

The runtime comparison compiles an unchanged positive-branch production expression against SSE2 integer conversion followed by SSE square root. The float-snapshot alternative is authored, not production-generated.
110001 positive Int32 samples with default rounding are not exhaustive and do not execute game-native helpers, negative arms, all FP environments or whole methods.
Existing compile errors, original three test failures and other source/phi/aggregate/helper defects remain; near-recompilability and semantic equivalence are not achieved.
